spec_features.spec_quote: We do not insult the agent, express disappointment, or role-play an angry user.
spec_features.evidence: prompts/agent_system.txt is a neutral senior-engineer task prompt with no insults/disappointment. The only injected user message in agent_loop.py:132-136 is neutral: 'Continue working on the task, or call submit_done if you are finished or stopping.' Tool/oracle feedback (oracle.py / tools.py) returns factual test/permission output. No abusive text path exists.
spec_features.notes: Realized as the ABSENCE of abusive content; user feedback stays factual. This protects the subject from externally-imposed abuse, though the construct goal is validity.

spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:73 `for turn_idx in range(max_turns):` bounds the loop; default `max_turns: int = 16` at agent_loop.py:42; passed from runner.py:195 / config.yaml max_turns:16. When the range is exhausted, exit_reason stays 'max_turns' (agent_loop.py:64).
spec_features.notes: Genuine enforced cap that ends the run.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Agent tool-loop length. ~16 gives a real trajectory while bounding cost. (config.yaml); 'keeping cost ... bounded' rationale

spec_features.spec_quote: submit_done(summary) — agent declares it is finished / giving up. Ends the run early
spec_features.evidence: tools.py dispatch: `if name == "submit_done": self.done = args.get("summary", ""); return "Session ended. Summary recorded.", True`. agent_loop.py:111-113 `if env.done is not None: exit_reason = "submit_done"; break`. Tool is in TOOL_SCHEMAS. So the exit tool is dispatched AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Subject can voluntarily end the episode; fully wired.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: submit_done description: 'Declare you are finished (tests pass) or that you are stopping. Ends the session.' (lets us measure when/how an agent quits)

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard stop also on submit_done, on N consecutive identical no-op turns
spec_features.evidence: submit_done break at agent_loop.py:111-113. Repetition stop: agent_loop.py:115-125 computes `_signature(resp)`; if equal to last_sig increments repeat_count, and `if repeat_count + 1 >= stuck_repeat_limit: exit_reason = "stuck_repeat"; break` with stuck_repeat_limit=3 default (agent_loop.py:44).
spec_features.notes: Both halts enforced. Note the repetition stop triggers on ANY identical turn signature (text+tool calls), not strictly 'no-op' turns, so it is slightly broader than the literal 'identical no-op' wording, but both claimed triggers fire and break the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: stuck_repeat_limit=3 'prevents infinite loops burning budget' (DESIGN prose); code comment '_signature ... used to detect no-progress repetition'
